hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: Implements a 1:1 ETH↔phiEth custom swap curve by intercepting swaps in beforeSwap: takes the input token from the PoolManager, calls phiEth.deposit() or phiEth.withdraw() to convert, settles the output, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to bypass the AMM's concentrated liquidity. Direct liquidity additions are permanently blocked.
